map.算法：负载换牛顿 loadN = 负载×9.8；导轨动额定需求 = loadN×: Algorithm: load to Newton loadN = load times 9.8; guide dynamic rating requirement = loadN times 6 / 1000 (kN), take the first value greater than or equal to the requirement from [7.7,13.6,17.6,27.5,35.1,51.4,74.4,101] corresponding to HGR15 to HGR65; screw lead by speed times 1000 / 3000 in [5,10,20,32,40] take the first greater than or equal; required rpm = speed times 1000 / lead; accuracy grade less than or equal to 10 um choose C3, less than or equal to 20 um choose C5, less than or equal to 50 um choose C7, otherwise C10; total screw length = stroke times 1.3; screw diameter by loadN tiers (greater than 5000 N take 32 mm, greater than 2000 N take 25 mm, greater than 500 N take 20 mm, otherwise 16 mm); drive torque = loadN times lead / (2 pi times 0.9 times 1000) (N m, 0.9 is screw efficiency).
map.例：定位精度 10μm、负载 50kg、行程 500mm、速度 15m/min: Example: positioning accuracy 10 um, load 50 kg, stroke 500 mm, speed 15 m/min gives loadN 490 N, guide HGR15 (dynamic rating 7.7 kN), screw 16 mm / lead 5 mm, accuracy C3, total screw length 650 mm, rpm 3000, drive torque 0.433 N m, lead accuracy plus or minus 3 um/300 mm. If load 200 kg, stroke 800 mm, speed 30 m/min, accuracy 5 um gives loadN 1960 N, guide HGR20 (13.6 kN), screw 20 mm / lead 10 mm, total length 1040 mm, rpm 3000, torque 3.466 N m, lead accuracy plus or minus 5 um/300 mm.
map.导程怎么在转速和推力之间取舍？: How to trade off lead between rpm and thrust?
map.小导程推力大、分辨率高但同速度下需要更高转速；大导程反之。工具按最高 3000r: A smaller lead gives greater thrust and higher resolution but requires higher rpm at the same speed; a larger lead is the opposite. The tool back-calculates the minimum lead at a maximum 3000 rpm; if the selected lead drives rpm to 3000, it means a larger lead or lower speed requirement is needed.
map.丝杠总长为什么乘 1.3？: Why multiply total screw length by 1.3?
map.行程之外还要容纳螺母、两端支承与锁紧结构，1.3 为工程估算系数；实际须按支承方: Beyond the stroke it must also accommodate the nut, both-end supports and locking structure; 1.3 is an engineering estimate coefficient; in practice it must be checked against the support method (fixed-fixed / fixed-supported) and end dimensions, and the critical speed and column buckling stability must be verified.
